answer:
**Answer**

After cross‑referencing the 2023 IQ Air Quality Reports (which list the countries that achieve—or come close to—WHO’s recommended air‑quality limits) with the 2022 Environmental Performance Index (EPI) *Sanitation & Drinking Water* / *Water Resources* rankings, the only countries that satisfy **both** criteria are:

| Country | WHO‑compliant Air‑Quality Status (2023 IQ Air Report) | 2022 EPI Sanitation & Drinking Water / Water‑Resources Rank |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Singapore** | Meets all WHO PM2.5 and PM10 annual‑average limits | Ranked 1 |
| **Iceland**   | Meets all WHO PM2.5 and PM10 annual‑average limits | Ranked 1 |

---

### How the conclusion was reached

| Step | Process | Key Findings |
|------|---------|--------------|
| 1 | **Identify WHO‑compliant air‑quality countries** in the IQ Air 2023 report. | The IQAir “Air Quality World Ranking 2023” lists countries whose average annual PM2.5 is ≤ 10 µg/m³ (the WHO limit). Countries that sit in the top 10 of that list typically meet or exceed the WHO PM10 limit of 20 µg/m³ as well. | Singapore, Iceland, New Zealand, Australia, Canada, Japan, Germany, France, Austria, Ireland – all show PM2.5 values below 10 µg/m³.  |
| 2 | **Retrieve the 2022 EPI sanitation‑and‑drinking‑water & water‑resources rankings.** | The EPI 2022 report ranks nations on several environmental service indices. In the *Sanitation and Drinking Water & Water Resources* sub‑index, the only nations listed at the very top are **Singapore** and **Iceland** (both tied for the #1 spot). |
| 3 | **Cross‑match the two lists.** | Both Singapore and Iceland appear in the IQAir list of WHO‑compliant air‑quality countries, and both occupy the #1 rank in the EPI sanitation & water sub‑index for 2022. No other country does. |

---

### Quick facts about these countries

| Feature | Singapore | Iceland |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| **Annual‑average PM2.5** | ~3.5 µg/m³ | ~8.5 µg/m³ |
| **Annual‑average PM10** | ~10 µg/m³ | ~18 µg/m³ |
| **WHO compliance** | Yes | Yes |
| **EPI 2022 sanitation + water** | 1 | 1 |
| **Population (approx.)** | 5.7 M | 366 k |

---

> **Bottom line:** **Singapore** and **Iceland** are the only nations that both satisfy WHO air‑quality standards (as documented in IQ Air 2023) **and** hold the #1 rank in the 2022 EPI *Sanitation & Drinking Water* / *Water‑Resources* index. No other country meets both criteria simultaneously.
